properties.description: Occupancy equals an independent depth-16 queue model, including simultaneous operations, rejected boundary transfers, and synchronous reset.
Full is asserted exactly when the independent expected queue contains 16 words.
Empty is asserted exactly when the independent expected queue contains zero words.
Whenever the expected queue is nonempty, the asynchronous front output equals its oldest accepted, unread word; empty data is not checked.
After initialization, the reported occupancy is known and within the legal range zero through 16.
After a synchronous reset edge and until the next edge, occupancy is zero, full is deasserted, and empty is asserted.
